target_customer: Shoppers of vintage clothing, plus partner vintage stores that get an automated listing channel
problem: Finding good vintage in your size and style across scattered stores is slow; AI curation and personalization aim to fix that.
business_model: Marketplace selling curated pieces sourced from partner vintage stores (take rate not public)

founders.name: Sandra Lifshits
founders.background_notes: YC launch post says she volunteered at New York vintage stores.

founders.name: Maddy Yip
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder in the YC launch post; the YC company page lists only Sandra.

competitors.name: Depop
competitors.what: Peer to peer resale marketplace adding AI listing generation
competitors.traction_then: AI listing from one photo launched September 2024
competitors.funding_then: Owned by a larger parent, not captured

competitors.name: Vestiaire Collective
competitors.what: Luxury resale marketplace with AI image and keyword search

competitors.name: Fleek
competitors.what: Wholesale secondhand and vintage clothing marketplace

technical_complexity.rationale: Recommendation, trend analysis and AI shopper features over partner inventory are standard applied ML; the hard part is inventory sourcing and fulfillment, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Large resale platforms ship similar AI features and partner store inventory is not exclusive, so copying is easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI listing and search features in late 2024; no source shows Retrofit acquired or displaced.

market_need_then: Secondhand fashion was growing and AI discovery tools were launching at major platforms in late 2024; Retrofit-specific demand evidence was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses retrofit.shop, a .shop domain; the site is a script-loaded page whose content could not be read.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Personal shopper framing, Your Vintage Personal Shopper

brand_strength.rationale: A retro-flavored real word fits vintage, but it is generic and shared with the Retrofit construction and software terms; there is no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Retrofit is a two person team that is still listed active as of mid 2026 with no shutdown or acquisition reported. Funding evidence is limited to aggregators, and well funded rivals such as Fleek raised far more in 2024 and 2026, so its prospects are unproven.
notes: Unverified funding: VCBacked and TheCompanyCheck list about $500K pre-seed in March 2025 from Y Combinator; YesPress calls it seed; StartupHub claims $31M and Series C, which is implausible for a team of 2.
